units.source_text: 佐田的店铺好歹是中京 [1] 的一家绸缎批发店。

en.t: Sada's shop was at least a silk wholesaler in Nakagyo [1].

units.source_text: 周围的店铺大都改为股份公司了。

en.t: Most of the surrounding shops had become joint-stock companies.

units.source_text: 佐田的店铺也跟它们一样，形式上是家股份公司。

en.t: Sada's shop, like the others, was formally a joint-stock company.

units.source_text: 太吉郎当然是担任经理，不过买卖都由掌柜（如今改为专务或常务）掌管。

en.t: Taikichiro was of course the manager, but the business was run by the head clerk, now called an executive director or managing director.

units.source_text: 但是，现在多少还保留着昔日店铺的老规矩。

en.t: Even now, however, some of the old customs of the shop still remained.
